key_highlights: ASX inched higher on energy and big miner rally, but BHP faces pressure as iron ore prices crumble
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; RBA signals it will not intervene to support property
Mortgage costs driving Australians into second jobs, signalling household stress
Gold exploration sector active: Forrestania hits 2Moz, Kaiser reloads Tassie inventory, Larvotto strikes in NSW, Aureka acquires Victorian mine for $8.9M
BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point, reshaping automotive and energy transition landscape
Iran conflict forces rewrite of global oil trade routes; tanker wars unlikely to suppress oil prices
Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network, consolidating media ownership
Qantas engine flame incident raises aviation safety and insurance scrutiny

sectors.trend: Divergent: iron ore weakness pressures BHP and FMG, while gold exploration names (Forrestania, Kaiser, Larvotto, Aureka, Manhattan) show strong discovery momentum
sectors.implications: Rotation from iron ore to gold and critical minerals; small-cap explorers attract speculative flows but large-cap miners face margin compression

sectors.trend: Energy stocks rallied on ASX; Iran conflict and tanker wars support oil price floor; BYD EV adoption accelerates structural demand shift
sectors.implications: Wesleyan, Woodside, and Santos benefit from oil resilience; EV transition pressures legacy auto supply chains but supports battery metals

sectors.trend: Accelerating housing price falls and RBA refusal to cut rates create credit risk overhang; mortgage stress rising with second-job uptake
sectors.implications: CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC face rising NPL risk in residential lending; insurance premiums rising on car supply crunch

sectors.trend: BYD EV tipping point disrupts automotive; Stokes family consolidates Seven Network; airfares surging pressures travel demand
sectors.implications: WES, WOW face margin pressure from input costs; Seven (SVL.AX) governance shift may alter dividend policy

sectors.trend: AI hardware rally vs. software pullback globally; cheap drones disrupting Australian defence procurement
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech and defence names (e.g., OZK, WES) may see re-rating; drone supply chain opportunities

key_themes: Iron ore price weakness vs. gold exploration boom
RBA hawkish stance amid accelerating housing downturn
Household financial stress and second-job economy
EV transition accelerating in Australia via BYD
Geopolitical oil supply disruption (Iran, tanker wars)
Aviation safety and insurance cost escalation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market acceleration in price falls
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to REITs and residential mortgage-backed financials; favour commercial and industrial property

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price deterioration pressuring BHP/FMG margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and critical minerals exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical oil supply disruption (Iran, tanker wars)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain energy sector allocation; monitor WTI/Brent for volatility spikes

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Household credit stress and rising NPLs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL disclosures; favour banks with lower residential exposure (CBA.AX over ANZ.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AVGAS/aviation safety and insurance cost escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor Qantas (QAN.AX) operational risk; review insurance sector valuations

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration and production names
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser Tassie, Larvotto NSW, Aureka Victorian acquisition) signal sector upcycle; gold hedges geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain energy sector allocation on oil resilience
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict and tanker wars support oil price floor; energy stocks already rallying on ASX
BYD confirms Australia EV tipping point; structural demand for lithium, nickel, copper

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and bank exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating housing falls, RBA inaction, and rising mortgage stress elevate credit and valuation risk
Iron ore price crumble threatens BHP and FMG earnings; 'mulls suicide' commentary signals severe margin pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge with quality dividend payers and cash
defensive_moves.rationale: Household stress and geopolitical uncertainty favour defensive positioning

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with sector rotation: energy and gold outperform, iron ore and financials lag. Housing data and RBA commentary will dominate. Qantas incident may briefly pressure QAN.AX.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift toward gold, critical minerals, and EV supply chains. Housing correction may extend 6-12 months given RBA inaction. Geopolitical oil risk supports energy valuations. EV adoption accelerates consumer sector disruption.
